protocol.scope: Warm-started restricted continuous five-parameter shot selection with the current fixed ball. Same 17 historical anchors for both methods. Prescribed held endpoints and sampled common-home/local paths; no grasp, driven motion, impact compliance, perception or physical validation.
protocol.family: Nearest shared TRAIN teacher, fixed source board XYZ/tilt/gap, query-facing heading; continuous bounded residuals, no global search or candidate-index policy
protocol.anchor_rule: Nearest source bucket Euclidean XY, tie source ID; fixed before outcomes; no fallback if geometry/path fails
protocol.observations: 9 geometry-only values: bucketXY, source bucketXY, five source action values; fixed normalization
protocol.sweep: One request per candidate: zero, ten axis offsets, ten seeded space-filling samples, then TRAIN-best latent jitter. Heldout prediction transfers nearest TRAIN context's best normalized residual; no outcome query.

ppo.episode: One terminal shot decision; no GAE/bootstrap; actual native reward updates

protocol.reward: Unchanged learning_contract.reward: invalid -1, native board/entry/proximity/retention shaping; success remains the independent board-route capture rule
protocol.sample_definition: Every requested training decision, including bounds/IK/home/path rejects; native releases and CPU proposals reported separately

evaluation.perturbations: One nominal + two paired Gaussian placement jitters per layout; same offsets across methods/seeds/milestones
evaluation.selection: Validation captures, then mean reward, then earliest milestone; test only after selected artifact frozen
evaluation.test: One deterministic base action per layout; no search/retry/adaptation at evaluation
evaluation.full_denominator: All layouts and requested repetitions, including blocked/unresolved/rejected

resources.wall_s: Setup + training wall time, excluding validation/test
resources.cpu_s: Current worker process CPU time; external nvidia-smi telemetry subprocess CPU excluded
resources.gpu_s: Synchronized native pipeline elapsed wall time, not active kernel utilization
resources.gpu_reservation_s: Elapsed exclusive 4090 worker reservation including evaluation
resources.memory: MiB; lifetime process peaks include evaluation; NVIDIA process VRAM sampled every1s, PyTorch allocator separately
resources.storage: Algorithm artifacts separate from audit raw-data storage

prior.scope: Shared historical starting information, not 17 free cold-start labels. Latest two studies cost 4234 native releases; predecessor acquisition, contact tuning and human design costs are not fully quantified.
